title: AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic large language models have been documented to lose reasoning capability when placed inside a harness, the software that mediates their observations and actions. To reconcile these losses, we introduce AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that adapts an agent to a task the way a trainer onboards a new employee. It places the agent under the supervision of an intelligent ``Onboarder'' coding agent, which iteratively tailors its foundation model, prompt, and harness source code to simultaneously improve performance and decrease cost. Like a real onboarding process, the Onboarder is only given tens of examples, and all evaluation data is isolated on a separate virtual machine to prevent leakage. We report the lessons learned from building and testing AutoOnboarder on genomic-sequencing prior authorization form submission. translated_title: AutoOnboarder：自主引导大语言模型智能体上手工作
translated_abstract: 有记录表明，智能体大语言模型在被置于“线束”（harness，即调解其观察与行动的软件）中时会丧失推理能力。为了解决这一性能损失，我们提出了AutoOnboarder，这是一个自主系统，它像培训师引导新员工入职那样让智能体适应任务。该系统将智能体置于一个智能的“引导员”编码智能体的监督之下，引导员会迭代地定制其基础模型、提示词和线束源代码，以同时提升性能并降低成本。如同真实的入职流程一样，引导员仅获得数十个示例，且所有评估数据都隔离在一台单独的虚拟机上，以防止信息泄露。我们报告了在基因组测序预授权表单提交任务上构建和测试AutoOnboarder过程中汲取的经验教训。经自主引导的智能体能够达到或超越Gemini 3.5 Flash基线的性能……
tldr: AutoOnboarder提出了一种自主引导系统，由“引导员”编码智能体像培训新员工一样，仅凭数十个示例迭代优化基础模型、提示词和线束代码，使LLM智能体达到或超越Gemini 3.5 Flash基线性能并同时降低成本。
en_tdlr: AutoOnboarder introduces an autonomous onboarding system in which an "Onboarder" coding agent iteratively tailors the foundation model, prompt, and harness source code—like a trainer onboarding a new employee—enabling LLM agents to match or exceed a Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline with only tens of examples while reducing cost.
